PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Integrations.Title: External Integrations
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Integrations.Hint: Detected Forge modules and whether Encounter Forge uses them.
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Integrations.Note: Modules that are not installed or are disabled in Foundry cannot be enabled here. These switches only control whether Encounter Forge uses an integration that is technically ready.
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Deployment.Title: Deploy Encounter
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Deployment.Hint: Materialize the planned opponents as World Actors, stage them on a Scene, and create a persistent prepared Encounter Instance.
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Deployment.SceneHin: The Instance remembers this Scene. Opponents can be placed automatically in a compact staging formation or positioned interactively on the map.
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Deployment.ActorFol: Choose an existing Actor folder or create an Encounter-specific subfolder below it.
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Deployment.CreateSu: Create a new subfolder for this Encounter Instance
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Deployment.ActorMod: Per type creates one World Actor per participant template. Per participant creates a separate World Actor for every concrete opponent.
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Deployment.Prepared: Deployment creates World Actors and a prepared Encounter Instance. With a selected Scene, concrete opponents can now be staged as Tokens and optionally added to a prepared Combat. The Encounter Runtime and Director are not started yet.
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Notifications.Deplo: Add at least one participant before deployment.
The Encounter could not be deployed. Actors, Tokens, Combat data, and new folders created by the failed attempt were rolled back where possible.
Encounter Instance prepared: {actors} World Actors and {tokens} Tokens in {folder}; {combat}.
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Deployment.SceneSet: Prepare concrete opponent Tokens and optionally a Foundry Combat. Choose automatic staging or place every opponent directly on the map.
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Deployment.PlaceTok: Place opponents as Tokens on the Scene
Creates exactly one Token for every concrete Encounter participant and links it to the Encounter Instance.
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Deployment.Placemen: Automatic: compact formation at Scene center
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Deployment.CreateCo: Creates a Foundry Combat and adds the generated opponent Tokens as Combatants. Initiative is not rolled and combat is not started.
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Deployment.IncludeP: Also add existing PC Tokens to Combat
Adds all character Tokens already present on the selected Scene to the prepared Combat as well.
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Deployment.ViewScen: Switches to the selected Scene after automatic deployment. Manual placement always opens the selected Scene and leaves Encounter Forge minimized afterwards.
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Deployment.NoSceneP: Choose a Scene to enable Token placement and Combat preparation.
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Deployment.Placemen: Manual: place each opponent on the map
Manual placement switches to the selected Scene and uses Foundry's Token placement preview for each opponent in encounter order.
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Deployment.Interact: Manual placement temporarily closes this dialog and minimizes Encounter Forge. Left-click each Token position on the Scene; Esc cancels the deployment and rolls back newly created deployment documents.
PF2E_ENCOUNTER_FORGE.Notifications.Place: Interactive placement cancelled. Actors, Tokens, Combat data, and new folders created by this deployment attempt were rolled back where possible.
